title: Magician
author: Raymond E. Feist
summary: Two orphan boys grow up in a castle on the edge of a kingdom, one destined to become a magician and the other a warrior. An invasion from another world pulls them into an enormous war.
readIf: you like classic, big-canvas fantasy that mixes personal growth with armies on the march.
skipIf: you want sharply drawn modern prose or a morally complex tone.

pairings.reason: Another long-running classic fantasy series that starts from simple beginnings and grows enormous.
A friendlier, more comic traditional fantasy with a boy hero and a found family.
A short, quiet story of a gifted boy learning magic and responsibility.
